WTH (What the Hook?) is a live Uniswap v4 swap rebate hook deployed on Robinhood Chain that internalizes cross-pool arbitrage profit and redistributes it to the traders and liquidity providers who created the opportunity — rather than allowing external bots to extract it. When a swap creates a price gap between connected pools, WTH's on-chain hook detects, captures, and settles the correction within the same transaction. Realized profit is split automatically: traders receive rebates on their trades, and liquidity providers earn a larger share streamed directly into connected pools.

A meme coin on Robinhood chain. Nobody knows what he is. He looks funny.

Roo is a small fuzzy thing with pale green skin, a beard, stick legs and hair that points straight up. Nobody knows what he is, including the people who made this coin. He looks funny. That is the whole coin.

Fables is a dynamic-fee ve(3,3) DEX built on Uniswap v4 and live on Robinhood Chain. At TGE, $PROLOGUE will redeem for the governance token at a fixed ratio. Every Fable starts somewhere. This is only the Prologue.
Hold $ORBIO, earn OpenRouter credits. Half of trading fees are converted into inference credits and paid to holders, in dollars.

Robinhood GLD is a tokenized representation of SPDR Gold Shares (GLD) common stock, issued on Robinhood Chain, Robinhood's own blockchain built to bring tokenized real-world assets on-chain. Each token is designed to track the price of the underlying GLD share, giving holders on-chain price exposure to SPDR Gold Shares's stock. The token is freely transferable and composable across the Robinhood Chain ecosystem. It's part of Robinhood's broader initiative to expand access to tokenized U.S. equities via blockchain technology, alongside a wider lineup of tokenized stock tokens launching on the s

HOODPORK is a meme coin on Robinhood Chain built around PORKU, a green hooded pig and the “only up” joke. It brings holders together through art, humor, and community activities like listings, raids, and merch ideas. The token launched with no buy or sell tax, locked liquidity, a renounced contract, and a 1 billion supply. $PORKU is a meme coin with no intrinsic value or promised financial return.

Hold the coin, get paid in stocks. The Index turns trading activity into real stock ownership. Every time $INDEX is traded, a 3% fee is collected in ETH and used to buy a basket of 18 tokenized stocks on Robinhood Chain. Those stocks are sent straight to holders' wallets — automatically, onchain, every 15 minutes. No claiming, no staking. The more the coin is traded, the more stocks the community owns.

Agent Wormhole is a security layer for AI agents that transact with money. The project addresses a specific attack surface: AI agents read text (token metadata, tool descriptions, web pages, messages from other agents) and act on it, which allows hidden instructions in that text to manipulate an agent's behavior. Goldstein (GLDSTN) is the token of Goldstein Group, an on-chain investment firm on Robinhood Chain (chain ID 4663). The firm’s product is the G-fund: a token that holds underlying assets and can be redeemed for a share of those assets. Described fund types include a dollar savings token (gUSDG), leveraged long and short tokens such as gETH3x and gETH3xShort that borrow on Morpho markets and are rebalanced by a keeper, and basket tokens managed under published mandates. The firm is organized around 2,520 membership seats issued as NFTs. Seat holders can issue funds and receive a share of fees.

$CANNACAT is the token powering the CannaCat ecosystem connecting meme culture, the 420 CannaCats NFT collection, community rewards, staking, and The Vault.

Built on Robinhood Chain, $CANNACAT is designed around a simple idea: build together, reward participation, and grow the Collective.

🐈‍⬛ One Cat. One Collective. One Flywheel.
